meta.title: Creative Teams | Cluega
meta.description: Designers, editors and creators use Cluega — frontier AI models, layer control and team collaboration fused into one; from concept generation and remixing variants to fine detail work, everything happens on the same boundless canvas, and every generation is infused with real, proven viral conversion logic.

hero.title: Let creation keep pace with your thinking
hero.subtitle: Designers, editors and creators use Cluega — frontier AI models, layer control and team collaboration fused into one; from concept generation and remixing variants to fine detail work, everything happens on the same boundless canvas, and every generation is infused with real, proven viral conversion logic.

items.title: A boundless creative canvas where intelligence converges
items.body: Every asset is laid out visually and flat, putting a definitive end to the folder hell of never finding your files. You can zoom out for a bird’s-eye view of the whole project at any moment, or zoom instantly to pixel-level detail — concept generation, remixing variants and fine detail work all happen in one place.

items.title: No more blind generation — every click leaves a trail
items.body: The ART engine no longer generates blindly. It connects deeply to CDP ad performance and IM customer-conversion data, automatically identifies high-conversion DNA, and mass-multiplies it into a stronger asset matrix — so creative grows on real ROI.

items.title: Shoulder to shoulder with industry leaders
items.body: Access 400+ models, monitor ad markets in 184+ languages, sub-50ms response — hand the heaviest generation and retrieval compute to a creative core proven at scale.

lifecycle.title: One platform, running the full creative process from inspiration to finished cut

tabs.tab: A creative core built on viral big data
tabs.subtitle: Every generation, infused with viral conversion logic
tabs.body: Every time you generate an asset, the system retrieves viral hits and hot topics in real time behind the scenes — locking onto trending tags and deconstructing the logic of the top 1% of viral copy, injecting “viral conversion logic” straight into your copy, assets and video.

tabs.subtitle: Blend your product perfectly into any scene
tabs.body: Through image-to-image technology, it precisely analyzes lighting and structure, blending your product perfectly into the scene to create high-quality imagery — no manual tweaking of tedious parameters.

tabs.subtitle: Weeks of image production, cut down to minutes
tabs.body: Through structured workflows, generate matrix-style batches across multiple products, producing high-quality assets at lightning speed — a month of social content, done in minutes and auto-scheduled across channels.

tabs.subtitle: While you sleep, AI finds your rival’s hand from last night
tabs.body: Every TikTok, Meta or Instagram link you mention while chatting with AI, Cluega automatically ingests and analyzes in the background. After you close the window, the engine keeps running through the small hours — by morning you’ll receive yesterday’s results and a benchmarked creative brief.

built.title: Built for creative teams
built.overview: Cluega lets creators hand repetitive production to AI, and keep their time for real creativity.

cards.title: Chat is creation
cards.body: Give AI complex instructions in natural language; Cluega automatically plans the execution path, picks the best-fit model, and renders the result straight onto your canvas.

cards.title: Real-time online collaboration
cards.body: Support live team cursor trails, real-time comment feedback and parallel generation — you and the whole team spark ideas together in the same creative space.

cards.title: Precise local repainting
cards.body: Say goodbye to the long wait of regenerating the whole image! Just mark the area to adjust, and Cluega refines the detail precisely while perfectly preserving the original image elements.

quote.text: We handed the tedious grunt work — light compositing, local repainting — to AI, precisely so everyone can escape the pointless “image-editing hell” and save their brainpower for creativity that truly matters.
quote.name: Zerix
